title: Invitation: 20-min ramp review after activity surge
text:
Invitation: 20-min ramp review after activity surge

['From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ramp review? You crossed our activity threshold — 20-min catch-up

Hi Samir,

Congrats — we saw BrightPath spike usage in the last 48 hours (great signal). Our platform picked up a higher-than-average generation rate for a few jobs and flagged your project as a good candidate for a short, focused session to: 

- walk through a few latency/cost knobs that often help teams at this stage,
- show quick batching/cache settings that preserve latency but lower token costs, and
- answer any questions about model variants that fit your prompt patterns.

Would you be open to a 20-minute ramp review this week? I can do:
- Tue 5/24 10:00–10:20 PT
- Tue 5/24 14:00–14:20 PT
- Wed 5/25 09:30–09:50 PT

If none of those work, drop a couple times that do and I’ll coordinate. I’ll bring Rafael (solutions engineering) to run the quick perf checks. Attaching a short demo guide and a proposed agenda.

Thanks,

Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Attachments: redwood-quick-demo-guide.pdf (1.2MB), proposed-multipath-agenda.md
', "From: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightpath.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ramp review? You crossed our activity threshold — 20-min catch-up

Hi Monica,

Thanks — appreciate the heads up. Nice to see the trial moving along. I can do Tue 5/24 at 14:00 PT. Rafael joining sounds perfect — we'll have our infra lead (cc'ed below) on the call too.

Quick context: the spike is from a small internal pilot querying embeddings + generation for a new feature. We care most about cost per session and tail latency for 2–4k token requests.

Confirming 5/24 14:00 PT. Please send a calendar invite and any prep we should review.

Best,
Samir Kapoor
Senior Product Manager, BrightPath AI
samir@brightpath.ai

Cc: BrightPath AI <admin@brightpath.ai>
", "From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ramp review? You crossed our activity threshold — 20-min catch-up

Perfect — I've booked Tue 5/24 14:00–14:20 PT and sent a calendar invite (link below). Agenda is intentionally short:

1) 5 min — quick intro + confirm goals
2) 10 min — Rafael walks through 2 quick knobs (batching + KV/prefix cache) against examples you provided
3) 5 min — next steps and recommended config + trial credits if we need more headroom

Prep: if you can paste one anonymized sample prompt/trace, Rafael can point to concrete settings. If not, that's fine — we'll use general patterns.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.com/meeting/monica/5b2f
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/890123

See you Tuesday — Laura is looped for any follow through and to capture next steps in the account plan.

Thanks,
Monica

", 'From: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightpath.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightPath AI <admin@brightpath.ai>
Date: 2027-05-24T08:43:00-07:00
Subject: Need to move slot — conflict on our side

Hi Monica,

Apologies — a scheduling conflict came up on our side for the 14:00 PT slot. Would you be able to move the meeting by 30 minutes later (14:30 PT) or else to Wed 5/25 09:30 PT? The latter might be better for our infra lead.

Sorry for the short notice — happy to make either work if you have availability.

Thanks,
Samir
', "From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Samir Kapoor <samir@brightpath.ai>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-24T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Need to move slot — conflict on our side

Thanks for the heads up — totally fine. I've rescheduled to Wed 5/25 09:30–09:50 PT so your infra lead can join; updated calendar invite and agenda attached. If anything else changes, Laura will coordinate follow-ups.

Reschedule notes:
- New time: Wed 5/25 09:30 PT (20 min)
- Joining: Monica (AE), Rafael (SE), Samir + BrightPath infra lead
- Attachments: redwood-quick-demo-guide.pdf, proposed-multipath-agenda.md

See you Wednesday.

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
